prompt:
A game title-screen UI asset sheet on a fully transparent background. Exactly four separate elements, stacked top to bottom and centered, with wide empty transparent gaps between them (no element touches or overlaps another):
1. Top: a large ornate horizontal title emblem plaque, about 70% of the sheet width and 32% of its height, richly decorated at both ends and along the top and bottom, with a wide flat empty center panel that is a dark gunmetal-grey panel where a game logo will be placed later.
2. A long horizontal menu button plate in its highlighted state, about 56% of the sheet width and 10% of its height: ornate end caps and a thin trim, the center filled with a glowing safety-yellow panel.
3. The same long horizontal menu button plate in its normal state, exactly the same size and shape, with the center filled with a dark gunmetal-grey panel, calmer and less glowing.
4. Bottom: a small round medallion button, about 10% of the sheet width, with a plain a dark gunmetal-grey center.
Material and style for every element: brushed steel plate edging with small hex bolts and steel brackets painted with yellow-and-black hazard stripes. Crisp polished game-UI asset rendering, front view, evenly lit, consistent style across all four elements. The center panels are smooth and plain. No text, no letters, no numbers, no symbols, no icons, no background, no drop shadow, no scene.
